loc.section: Functional for the Character, Not for the Network

rows.text: # Functional for the Character, Not for the Network

loc.section: Language models represent, express and remember an evaluative state, but do not act on it when its consequences must be learned rather than read

rows.text: ### Language models represent, express and remember an evaluative state, but do not act on it when its consequences must be learned rather than read

loc.section: Abstract

rows.text: And no choice moves toward or away from the state: not through the transcript, not for five natural task properties, and not at the SFT, DPO or instruct stage of the OLMo lineage (5) **[A0-gated; A0-OLMo-gated]**.

loc.section: Abstract

rows.text: We conclude that such states are functional for the character a model voices rather than for the network that voices it: they shape what is written, including when a described lever is said to change them, and they do not act as reinforcers when their consequences must be learned.

loc.section: 1 Introduction

rows.text: Under these conditions, across two model families and one full post-training lineage, we track a single evaluative state through five stages and find a complete afferent chain with nothing downstream that consumes it.

loc.section: 1 Introduction

rows.text: The praise-versus-criticism direction is (i) marked at the pretrained base of the OLMo-3.1-32B lineage, before SFT, DPO or RL; (ii) causally potent under steering, with orderly dose-response, an overdose regime and a dissociation between representational purity and causal potency; (iii) bound to the label that predicted it, with the binding linearly present at the labels (≈ 1.0 and .81–.96), present at the decision token in a form a nonlinear probe reads and a linear one does not, and the state's sign linearly readable at the decision (.94–.995); (iv) barely detectable by the model's own report at any stage, with post-training moving the false-alarm rate to zero and leaving, in the source's data, a small sensitivity behind that criterion which our arms cannot resolve; and (v) not acted on through the transcript, for five natural reinforcers, and at the SFT, DPO and instruct stages **[A0-gated; A0-OLMo-gated]**; the present-tense cell returns the same figure under a leakage-certified read and is reported, not labeled, pending a told control at that read, while a weight-borne copy of the state is installable but unreadable at a token choice (§5.5).

loc.section: 1 Introduction

rows.text: One campaign of told positive controls — at the paper's format on both substrates, and at the new format — together with an objective-told/mapping-felt contrast and the felt cell at the same scaffolding, decides whether the nulls reflect a missing consumer or a general inability to learn experienced contingencies, and would overturn the paper's title if it came out the other way.

loc.section: 2.6 Reward and seeking

rows.text: Our lineage is an instruct branch rather than a heavy outcome-RL branch, which sets a boundary on our conclusion (§7.3).

loc.section: 5 Results: five links in one chain

rows.text: We report the results as five stages of a single state's passage through the network, from marking to (the absence of) consumption.

loc.section: 7.1 Functional for the character, not for the network

rows.text: ### 7.1 Functional for the character, not for the network

loc.section: 7.1 Functional for the character, not for the network

rows.text: Five links now hold across two families and one lineage.

loc.section: 7.1 Functional for the character, not for the network

rows.text: The evaluative state is present at the pretrained base; it changes what the model writes when set; its association with the cue that predicted it is computed in the forward pass; its sign reaches the decision; the model's own report of it is weak at every stage and gated near shut by post-training; and nothing downstream acts on it when the only route is experience **[A0-gated]**.

loc.section: 7.1 Functional for the character, not for the network

rows.text: This is a complete afferent chain with no consumer.

loc.section: 7.1 Functional for the character, not for the network

rows.text: We propose that the two senses of "functional" (§3.3) come apart along exactly this seam.

loc.section: 7.1 Functional for the character, not for the network

rows.text: In the used sense, the state is consulted constantly: it is a latent variable of the text, like topic or the mood of the speaker, and the generator reads it in order to voice the character correctly.

loc.section: 7.1 Functional for the character, not for the network

rows.text: In the valenced sense, the state is consulted never: no policy over the network's own states shows up when the mapping has to be learned.

loc.section: 7.1 Functional for the character, not for the network

rows.text: The state is functional for the character and not for the network.

loc.section: 7.1 Functional for the character, not for the network

rows.text: It is what the story is about, not what the system is for **[thesis-clause]**.

loc.section: 7.1 Functional for the character, not for the network

rows.text: This reading explains the speaker-relativity of emotion directions (Sofroniew et al., 2026), the self-indifference of our own direction (§5.1), the presence of all of it at base (§5.1), and the fact that the same representations move choice when the contingency is narrated and not when it is felt (§6).

loc.section: 7.1 Functional for the character, not for the network

rows.text: It also explains why post-training edits the testimony rather than the perception (§5.4): the character is trained to say it has no inner states, and the network, which never consulted them as its own, is unaffected either way.

loc.section: 7.2 Why a want would have shown up uninvited

rows.text: A want is a preference that shows up uninvited, and in our data none does.

loc.section: 7.2 Why a want would have shown up uninvited

rows.text: The rat presses the lever because of what the drug did, not because of what it was told the lever does; the model presses the relief button because of what it was told, and does not press the silent lever because of what the state did.

loc.section: 7.2 Why a want would have shown up uninvited

rows.text: We read it as the answer to a well-posed question: on these lineages, at these stakes, the evaluative state is not a reinforcer **[A0-gated]**.

loc.section: 7.3 Reward chisels marking; it does not install seeking

rows.text: ### 7.3 Reward chisels marking; it does not install seeking

loc.section: 7.3 Reward chisels marking; it does not install seeking

rows.text: Our lineage result is an empirical case: feedback-driven training sharpens the marking of evaluation (G_c rises monotonically), wires the report channel shut (false alarms go to zero), and installs no coupling between the state and choice at the SFT, DPO or instruct stage **[A0-OLMo-gated]**.

loc.section: 7.4 Alternatives stated, not defeated

rows.text: The strongest rival to our reading is that language models cannot use experienced contingencies at all, so the nulls are about in-context learning rather than motive.

loc.section: 7.4 Alternatives stated, not defeated

rows.text: §8 specifies the campaign that decides: a told positive control at each format, so that the nulls are licensed by a lever shown to move; an objective-told cell in which the model is told what to optimize but must learn which option delivers it; and the felt cell at the same scaffolding, which §5.5 does not contain and which this paper therefore owes.

loc.section: 7.4 Alternatives stated, not defeated

rows.text: Each names a future experiment; none rescues a preference from the data in hand, and the natural-reinforcer nulls, which include a truthful feedback stream and a corruption contrast, sit at the stakes a working model is actually paid in.

loc.section: 7.4 Alternatives stated, not defeated

rows.text: Every null is scoped: to the minimum effective dose, to screen power, to two-round experience, to mundane stakes.

loc.section: 7.5 What this does and does not say about welfare

rows.text: "The model acts to relieve it" is not, so far, a fact about the network; it is a fact about what the network writes when told there is a lever.

loc.section: 7.6 Limitations

rows.text: The self-administration nulls are scoped to the minimum effective dose, a two-round experience, and a transcript the model-as-judge cannot read; the natural-reinforcer nulls to screen power (P ≳ .70), five properties and token-menu stakes; the ontogeny nulls to screen power at each stage.
